text: This report provides an overview of Toronto Public Health's main accomplishments and programs provided to City of Toronto residents during 2023. This report also highlights some of the innovative strategies and program achievements, as well as Toronto Public Health's key priorities for Toronto in 2024 and beyond. The full 2023 year-in-review summary is provided in Attachment 1 of this report.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (March 11, 2024) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
